details: Major cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, and Solana, saw declines after the Federal Reserve maintained steady interest rates but presented hawkish economic projections. The Fed's updated inflation forecasts signaled a slower timeline for rate reductions, dampening a recent relief rally across risk assets. Bitcoin traded around $64,150, down approximately 2.2% over the past 24 hours, while Ethereum fell 3.6%.
title: Crypto Markets Wobble Amid Hawkish Fed Outlook

details: Ethereum's price traded near $1,747, hovering around a significant historical support zone of $1,600 to $1,700. The weekly Relative Strength Index (RSI) for ETH has reached its lowest point since the token's genesis, a pattern historically associated with market bottoms. However, whale activity has reportedly decreased by 86.6%, which could temper the confirmation of an immediate bullish reversal.
title: Ethereum Price Shows Rare Bottom Signal, Whale Activity Plunges

details: Rodney Burton, widely known as "Bitcoin Rodney," has entered a guilty plea in a substantial $1.8 billion cryptocurrency fraud case. This development marks a significant outcome in legal proceedings targeting prominent figures involved in alleged illicit activities within the crypto industry.
title: "Bitcoin Rodney" Pleads Guilty in $1.8 Billion Crypto Fraud

details: Stablecoin issuer Tether has announced the winding down of its aUSDT stablecoin and its associated Alloy platform. This strategic decision is aimed at enabling the company to refine its focus on its core stablecoin offerings and operations.
title: Tether Discontinues aUSDT Stablecoin and Alloy Platform

details: Strategy Inc. has further expanded its Bitcoin holdings by acquiring an additional 1,587 BTC, totaling approximately $100 million. This purchase reinforces the company's long-term Bitcoin accumulation strategy, coming shortly after a minor, symbolic sale of Bitcoin.
title: Strategy Buys 1,587 More Bitcoin for $100 Million
